dedupeResult: Repository code search and the accessible open pull-request changed-file inventory returned no existing canonical match for the four names, domains, submission routes or public submission addresses before creation. Each platform was consolidated into one opportunity.
emailVerificationLevel: WRIU's three relevant genre addresses and Smooth Jazz Club's mailbox were verified by first-party publication, syntax, explicit purpose and domain/context alignment. The Edge uses protected contact rendering and routes artists to its form; Indie Global 365 exposes no submission mailbox. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
formVerificationLevel: The Edge and Indie Global 365 expose public first-party submission forms. No login, mandatory payment or visible CAPTCHA was observed, but hidden live controls remain unverified. Indie Global 365 requires direct song and artwork uploads plus terms acceptance; The Edge requires an external music link and association eligibility.
safety: All four opportunities were queued as needs_manual_review. No form field was filled, no terms checkbox was accepted, no file, artwork or external link was uploaded, no email was sent, no account or login was used, no CAPTCHA was solved and no payment or submission action was completed.
